text: On data_seed 1, the existing N=128 seeds 20-21 trajectories reach the N=256 step-3000 val_mse_ratio (0.36-0.39) before step 3000. At that matched-loss checkpoint, read as control plus best-layer margin, is N=128 trained force R2 at or below the N=256 value (0.671-0.672)? If so, data_seed 1 shows no matched-loss force shortfall at N=256, unlike data_seed 0 (+0.06 to +0.07).
